product.title: Whey + Pre Stack
product.body_html:
Protein and pre-workout are the two most commonly bought supplements in any serious lifter's stack — and they are almost always bought separately. The Whey + Pre Stack puts Applied Nutrition's best in both categories together at a price that makes buying them apart look wasteful.

AN Critical Whey Protein (25 Servings) delivers 24g of protein per serving from a four-source grass-fed dairy protein blend at just 120 calories. The multi-source blend is deliberate — combining whey concentrate, isolate, and hydrolysate gives a broader amino acid release profile than single-source whey, supporting both immediate post-workout recovery and sustained muscle protein synthesis. Informed Sport certified on selected flavours, UK-made to GMP standards. 25 servings per pack.

AN ABE All Black Everything (375g) is one of the most complete pre-workout formulations in the Applied Nutrition range. Each scoop delivers 4g of citrulline for blood flow and pump, 3.25g of creatine monohydrate for strength and power, 2g of beta-alanine for muscular endurance, 200mg of caffeine and 100mg of theacrine for a clean and sustained energy curve without the hard crash of caffeine alone. This is a pre-workout built for people who train seriously and want a formula that actually matches their training intensity. Halal certified, batch-tested, UK-made. 30 servings per pack.

Protein for recovery and muscle growth. Pre-workout for performance and training output. Together they cover the two ends of every session — the start and the finish.

Normally LKR 32,000. Bundle price LKR 29,999. You save LKR 2000.
